description: John Roberts serves as the Real Estate & Development Manager for Freedom Real Estate & Capital, LLC, a full-service commercial real estate development company in Huntsville, Alabama. In this role, he oversees brokerage operations, development projects, acquisitions, marketing strategies, and external relations. Freedom is a 100% employee-owned ESOP and a sister company to Torch Technologies.
